CreateTime.description_en: The time when the operation was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp, measured in milliseconds
CreateTime.title: 创建时间。

EndTime.description_en: The time when the operation ended. This value is a UNIX timestamp, measured in milliseconds
EndTime.title: 结束时间。

OperationState.description_en:
The operation state. Valid values:

`IN_PROGRESS`: The operation is in progress.

`COMPLETED`: The operation completed.

`HUMAN_PROCESSING`: The operation requires manual intervention.

`FAILED`: The operation failed
OperationState.description_zh:
操作状态。取值范围：
IN_PROGRESS：执行中。
COMPLETED：已完成。
HUMAN_PROCESSING：人工介入。
FAILED：失败
OperationState.title: 操作状态。

StartTime.description_en: The time when the operation started. This value is a UNIX timestamp, measured in milliseconds
StartTime.title: 开始时间。

StateChangeReason.description_en: The reason for the state change
StateChangeReason.title: 状态转换原因。

Code.description_en:
The operation status code. Valid values:

`UserRequest`: The operation was initiated by a user.

`OutOfStock`: The requested ECS instance type is out of stock.

`NotAuthorized`: You are not authorized to perform the operation.

`QuotaExceeded`: A resource quota was exceeded.

`OperationDenied`: The operation was denied.

`AccountException`: An account exception occurred.

`NodeFailure`: An ECS node failed.

`BootstrapFailure`: A bootstrap action failed.

`ValidationFail`: The business logic validation failed.

`ServiceFailure`: A dependent service failed.

`InternalError`: An internal error occurred
Code.description_zh:
操作状态码。取值范围：
UserRequest：用户请求。
OutOfStock：请求的ECS实例类型无库存。
NotAuthorized：无权限。
QuotaExceeded：Quota超出。
OperationDenied：操作被拒绝。
AccountException：账号异常。
NodeFailure：ECS节点异常。
BootstrapFailure：引导失败。
ValidationFail：业务逻辑校验失败。
ServiceFailure：依赖的其他服务失败。
InternalError：内部错误
Code.title: 状态码。

Message.description_en: A human-readable message that provides details about the state change
Message.example: The requested resource is sold out in the specified zone, try other types of resources or other regions and zones.
Message.title: 状态变化信息。
